input.summary: Add Licensee Data ownership and ownership/licence-back of customization deliverables to Article III
input.comment: [Playbook] Article III currently sweeps everything, including the custom front end and enhancements we commission and pay for under Article VII(b), into Licensor-owned Licensed Technology, and the Agreement is silent on our trade, order and client data. We have added a carve-out confirming we retain our data and intellectual property, that deliverables we fund are ours (with Licensor keeping its pre-existing platform IP and granting us a perpetual licence to any embedded IP), and that there is no joint ownership.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (i) Licensee retains all right, title and interest in and to all data, information and content submitted, transmitted or generated by or on behalf of Licensee through the Licensed Technology, including trade, order, market and client data and Licensee's configurations ("Licensee Data"), and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Licensor any Licensee Data or any other intellectual property of Licensee; (ii) all customization work, client front ends, deliverables and work product created by Licensor specifically for Licensee and paid for by Licensee (including under Article VII(b)) shall be owned by Licensee, and Licensor hereby assigns all right, title and interest therein to Licensee, provided that Licensor retains ownership of its pre-existing Intellectual Property Rights and the Platform Software and hereby grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any Licensor Intellectual Property Rights embedded in such deliverables for Licensee's business purposes; and (iii) no Licensee Data, deliverable or work product shall be jointly owned by the parties.
